general.title: Shipping costs
general.description: Nova Shipping Costs: settings, tariffs, energy surcharges, tours, price check
general.noRights: This module needs the “Settings” or “Orders → Tours” permission.

overview.allGood: All good: tariffs imported, energy surcharges up to date, no warnings.
overview.warnEnergy: Energy surcharge {carrier} is not up to date (last fetch older than 36 hours or failed).
overview.warnPrices: Price check: one warning (fixed price below purchase). | Price check: {count} warnings (fixed price below purchase).
overview.warnNoMethods: No Nova shipping method active (Settings → Shipping).
overview.warnNoChannel: Shipping method “{name}” is active but not assigned to any sales channel.
overview.warnTask: Scheduled task “{name}” failed, is inactive or overdue – is the scheduled task runner running?
overview.tourDates: no upcoming tour date | one upcoming tour date | {count} upcoming tour dates
overview.methodsHelp: Shipping methods with technical name nova_versandkosten_… – activate and assign under Settings → Shipping and Sales channels.
overview.noChannel: not assigned to a sales channel
overview.noMethods: No Nova shipping methods found – reactivate the plugin.
overview.tasksHelp: Run daily if a scheduled task runner (cron or bin/console scheduled-task:run) is active.
overview.noTasks: No scheduled tasks found – update the plugin.

settings.salesChannelHelp: “All sales channels” = default values. Per channel a field inherits the default while the chain icon is closed. Same values as in the plugin configuration; Save stores the changes of all tabs.

configHint.title: Clearer: shipping costs module
configHint.text: The same settings, sorted by topic in tabs – together with tariffs, energy surcharges, tours and price check under Orders → Shipping costs.

tariffs.none: No tariff file imported yet. Without tariffs Shopware calculates as before.
tariffs.invalid: The stored tariff file is invalid – please import again.
tariffs.importHelp: Drop a CSV or JSON file here or choose one – it is checked right away. “Import” then replaces the current tariff file for all sales channels. CSV from Excel (semicolon, UTF-8 with or without BOM, also Windows-1252) works directly.
tariffs.paste: Content of the tariff file (JSON or CSV)
tariffs.empty: Please choose a file or paste the content.
tariffs.checked: File is valid: {name} ({products} products). Not saved yet.
tariffs.wrongType: “{name}” is not a CSV or JSON file. In Excel use “Save as → CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited)”.
tariffs.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB.
tariffs.readError: The file could not be read.
tariffs.exportHelp: To edit: export as CSV, change in Excel, save as CSV and import again.
tariffs.templatesHelp: Example files with made-up placeholder prices, or a blank template with header row and one commented example row per row type (# at the start of a line = comment).

columns.intro: One row per entry; the column “type” says what the row is. All prices net in euros (purchase). Header: type;product;carrier;option;name;zone;countries;max_kg;price_net;per_kg_net;per_100g_net;round_kg;amount_net;percent;kind;condition;limits;postcodes;months;pass_on
columns.carrier: Carrier: key (free, e.g. dhl, dpd, post – also used for the energy surcharge) and display name
columns.product: Shipping product; option = warenpost, kleinpaket, dpd or dhl; limits e.g. maxKg=31.5 maxDimsCm=120x60x60 maxLengthCm maxGirthCm maxGoodsValue singlePackage=1 allowBulky=0 basicTracking=1
columns.rate: Weight step: up to max_kg it costs price_net (one row per step and zone, ascending)
columns.rateKgColumns: product, zone, countries, price_net, per_kg_net, round_kg
columns.rateKg: Piece price + price per kg (weight rounded up to round_kg, default 0.1)
columns.rate100g: Piece price + price per started 100 g
columns.oversize: Bulky/oversize tier; condition (one is enough): lengthOver, lengthAtLeast, sideOver, volumeOverL, girthOver, exceedsDimsCm, weightOverKg, bulky=1; limits: lengthCm, girthCm, dimsCm, kg. The last matching tier applies
columns.surchargeColumns: product, name, kind, amount_net or percent
columns.surcharge: Surcharge; kind = fixed, percent, energy, peak or peakInPeak; optional countries, postcodes (also ranges 25846-25847), months (11 12), pass_on=1
columns.hintLists: Separate lists (countries, postcodes, months) with spaces; also several product IDs in “product” of a surcharge/oversize row.
columns.hintPairs: limits and condition as key=value pairs separated by spaces; dimensions as 35.3x25x5.
columns.hintDecimal: Decimal separator comma or dot; delimiter semicolon (German Excel) or comma.
columns.hintComment: Rows whose first column starts with # and empty rows are ignored.
columns.hintOption: Several products per shipping method are common (domestic/international); per country the cheapest matching one applies.
columns.hintSurcharge: The energy surcharge (kind = energy) has no amount – the percentage comes from the “Surcharges & energy” tab.

check.title: Price check
check.help: Fixed prices in the home country against the current purchase price (incl. energy surcharge, peak during the period) for typical parcels. Red = net sale below purchase. Weight limits of fixed prices (“applies up to X kg”, Prices tab) are applied as in the checkout.

order.title: Shipping costs
order.dimsMissing: Dimensions/weight missing for at least one item – calculated by shipping category (default values).
order.beipackTo: ADD-ON to order {number} – ship together with it.

request.title: Shipping costs on request
request.open: The customer chose “shipping costs on request”. The order was placed with 0.00 shipping; payment is open.
request.label: Shipping costs ({currency}, gross or tax-free like the order)
request.notify: Notify customer by e-mail (total + payment link)
request.apply: Apply shipping costs and notify customer
request.mailFailed: E-mail could not be sent (check the mail template).

energy.title: Energy surcharges
energy.help: Fetched automatically every day (scheduled task “nova_versandkosten.energy_fetch”). In “automatic” mode (settings per sales channel) the value valid on the day applies; on errors the last value stays and a notification is created. The manual value only applies in “manual” mode or until the first fetch.
energy.effective: Effective (key = carrier in the tariff file)
energy.fetchedWithErrors: Fetch partly failed – last values stay valid.

general.title: Tours
general.description: Own delivery tours: routes, tour dates, tour deliveries, notification
general.noPostcodes: Postcode coordinates are missing. Please update or re-activate the plugin.

dates.help: A date starts open: customers along all variants of the route can book. The first booking fixes the variant (the one with the smallest deviation for that customer); afterwards only customers along this variant. You can fix or change the variant here at any time.
dates.name: Name (optional)
dates.deadlineHelp: Last order day (inclusive). Empty = default from the settings.
dates.trailerHelp: with trailer (no freight goods without trailer)
dates.ownHelp: One-off trip: enter waypoints in driving order (at least two).
dates.confirmDelete: Delete this tour date? Orders keep their data.
dates.priceProfileHelp: Who drives? Sets prices and reach of this date (checkout, check when ordering, notification). Customers only see the price, never the profile name.

routes.help: Routes are templates for regular trips. Each route has one or more variants (ways) with waypoints in driving order. A customer's deviation = straight-line distance of the postcode to the waypoint line × detour factor.
routes.name: Name
routes.activeHelp: active (for hints on “shipping costs on request”)
routes.waypointsHelp: Waypoints in driving order – start, places on the way, destination. Enter postcode or place.
routes.confirmDelete: Delete this route with all variants? Tour dates remain but lose the route.

profiles.help: The tour price can depend on who drives. Each profile has a price for small parts/parcels/bulky goods up to a maximum deviation and freight tiers. Choose the profile on the tour date; without a choice the default profile from the “Own tours” settings applies. Detour factor and delivery countries stay as in the settings.
profiles.none: No own price profiles yet – all dates use the default profile.
profiles.name: Name
profiles.nameHelp: Internal only, never shown to customers.
profiles.freightTiersHelp: One tier per line “up to km = price”, e.g. “30=190” and “60=290”. Empty = no freight goods with this profile.
profiles.confirmDelete: Delete price profile “{name}”? {count} date(s) use it and fall back to the default profile.

deliveries.title: Tour deliveries
deliveries.help: Order along the route (km from start) – load the deliveries reached last first.
deliveries.outOfRange: outside the price range with the current variant
deliveries.none: No orders for this date yet.

notify.title: Subscribers along the route
notify.help: For an open date all variants count. Reach: with trailer up to the largest freight tier, otherwise up to the small-parts limit. The e-mail only names the date and postcode area, never the route. Each subscriber gets at most one e-mail per date.

subscribers.title: Tour notification: subscribers
subscribers.disabled: The tour notification is switched off in the plugin settings.

order.tour: Delivery with our own tour on {date}

cms.title: Heading (optional)
cms.defaultText: We regularly deliver with our own tour. Leave your e-mail and postcode and we will let you know when a tour comes near you.
cms.hint: Form with double opt-in and captcha. Only shown when the tour notification is switched on in the plugin settings.
